name: User Data Function as a Business Events Publisher from Real-Time Hub
description: **User Data Function as a Business Events Publisher from Real-Time Hub****Overview**Enable users to create and configure User Data Functions (UDFs) as Business Events publishers directly from Real-Time hub—bringing custom logic, programmability, and real-time event emission into a unified experience.**Key Capabilities*** UDF Publisher Creation from Real-Time Hub: Launch and configure User Data Functions directly from Real-Time hub to publish Business Events without leaving the experience.* Code-First Event Publishing: Use Python-based UDFs to define custom logic for event generation and publishing, enabling advanced scenarios beyond out-of-the-box publishers.* Built-in Event Publishing Integration: Leverage integrated Business Events client libraries within UDFs to emit events aligned with defined schemas.* Schema-Aligned Payload Generation: Ensure event payloads conform to standardized Business Event schemas, improving consistency across publishers and consumers.* Flexible Trigger & Execution Model: Invoke UDFs from Notebooks, pipelines, or scheduled workflows to publish Business Events based on custom logic and conditions.
